sentences.en: My house is designed so as to withstand an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 我的房子设计得足以抵御地震。

sentences.en: We know well how to withstand all kinds of difficulties.
sentences.zh: 我们深知如何应对各种困难。

sentences.en: Morality is mostly a matter of how much temptation you can withstand.
sentences.zh: 道德主要是看你能够抵抗多少诱惑。
